primary_anchor_zh: 宽脸、白色短卷发和墨蓝色工作外套
story_reason_zh: 他去帘幕后取支架，随后回到工作桌

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 年长拉丁裔男木偶师在晨光照入的小型木偶工作室，用单手让一只大型布偶缓慢点头。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 用单手让一只大型布偶缓慢点头
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 宽脸、白色短卷发和墨蓝色工作外套占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由小舞台帘幕缓慢走出画面；随后呈现空工作椅、大型布偶和木质小舞台。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由小舞台帘幕缓慢走出画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 空工作椅、大型布偶和木质小舞台

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由小舞台帘幕缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由小舞台帘幕缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新清楚展示宽脸、白色短卷发和墨蓝色工作外套，并保持相近景别与主体占比。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames an older Latino man with a broad face, short white curls, and an ink-blue work jacket at a worktable in a morning-lit puppet studio. He makes one large cloth puppet nod slowly with a single hand.

A fixed medium shot shows an older Latino man with a broad face, short white curls, and an ink-blue work jacket walking slowly behind the small stage curtain until he leaves the frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty work chair, the large cloth puppet, and the small wooden stage. A thin stage curtain shifts gently.

A fixed medium shot shows an older Latino man with a broad face, short white curls, and an ink-blue work jacket walking slowly back from behind the small stage curtain and settling at a worktable in a morning-lit puppet studio.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 主体经由小舞台帘幕缓慢走出画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 空工作椅、大型布偶和木质小舞台
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 主体经由小舞台帘幕缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
